claim: 瑜伽行为与中观并立、起源于印度的大乘两大哲学传统之一。
locator: SEP Yogacara：'Alongside Madhyamaka, Yogācāra is one of the two major philosophical traditions of Mahāyāna Buddhism that originated in India.'；SEP Madhyamaka：'was one of the two principal schools of Mahāyāna Buddhism in India, the other school being the Yogācāra'
note: 两条 SEP 互证。

claim: 瑜伽行影响及于印度以外，尤其中国、日本、西藏。
locator: SEP Yogacara：'had a great impact on the development of Buddhist thought not only in the Indian subcontinent but also in other parts of Asia, especially in China, Japan and Tibet.'

claim: 学派得名诸说：或本于《瑜伽师地论》；yogācāra=yoga（禅修义）+ācāra（实践）。
locator: SEP Yogacara §1.1：'One possibility is that it refers to the foundational treatise (śāstra) of the tradition, the Yogācārabhūmi ("The Stages of Yogācāra")'；'The compound yogācāra consists of the words yoga and ācāra. The latter means practice.'；'in this context it presumably refers to meditation or some sort of mental cultivation'
uncertainty: 来源明言是'诸解释之一'（One possibility），非定论。

claim: 学派别名 vijñānavāda/cittamātra/vijñaptimātra；共同主张可感世界依心而被认知；西方哲学称之为观念论标签。
locator: SEP Yogacara §1.1：'The Yogācāra school is also known by various other names, including vijñānavāda ("doctrine of consciousness"), cittamātra ("mind only"), and vijñaptimātra ("cognition only")'；'the sensible world depends for its nature and existence on being cognised by a mind'；'In Western philosophy, this position is commonly labelled as "idealism", an umbrella term'
note: 此即'唯识'与'唯了别'译名问题的来源级表述。

claim: 传统六识之外，古典瑜伽行立八识：第七染污意与第八藏识。
locator: SEP Yogacara §2：'In contrast to this traditional model, classical Yogācāra distinguishes eight types of consciousness or cognition.'；'a seventh type, commonly referred to as defiled or afflicted mind (kliṣṭamanas), and an eighth form of consciousness, called store or substratum consciousness (ālayavijñāna)'
note: 开篇导言另有 'the eightfold classification of consciousness' 句。

claim: 染污意负责执我；恒以藏识为所缘。
locator: SEP Yogacara §2.1：'is responsible for our mistaken belief in the self and our sense of personal identity'；§2：'The kliṣṭamanas is directed at the ālayavijñāna as its object'

claim: 藏识=业种子/习气的容器；保证无我论下业力连续与人格相续归属。
locator: SEP Yogacara §2.2：'actions produce karmic seeds (bīja) or impressions (vāsanā) … which are retained, as in a sort of "container" or "store", in the ālayavijñāna until they are ready to produce their effects'；'grounds karmic continuity and efficacy over both one and multiple lifetimes and ensures that karmic results belong to the same personal "continuum" that committed the action'

claim: 三十颂三能变结构：异熟/思量/了别境识；藏识'恒转如瀑流'。
locator: 维基文库《唯識三十論頌》逐字：'由假說我法　有種種相轉　彼依識所變　此能變唯三'／'謂異熟思量　及了別境識'／'初阿賴耶識　異熟一切種'／'恒轉如瀑流　阿羅漢位捨'
note: 维基文库所载为颂文夹注本，颂字逐字命中。

claim: 《二十论》答辩结构：论敌三点（时空规则性/主体间共见/外境作用），世亲以梦、饿鬼地狱共见、梦失作答。
locator: SEP Yogacara §3.4：'Vasubandhu's (hypothetical) opponent gives three reasons…'；'In dreams, for instance, objects can appear to us in patterns of spatio-temporal determination.'；'answered by appealing to the shared experiences of pretas (hungry ghosts) and beings in hell'；'even unreal objects can produce real changes in our waking life'
note: 与 S8 汉译四难颂逐点对应（处时决定/相续不决定/作用）。

claim: 《二十论》汉译开篇标宗与四难颂、三喻答颂为逐字原文。
locator: 维基文库《唯識二十論》逐字：'安立大乘三界唯識。以契經說三界唯心。心意識了名之差別。此中說心意兼心所。唯遮外境不遣相應。內識生時似外境現。如有眩瞖見髮蠅等。此中都無少分實義'；'若識無實境　則處時決定　相續不決定　作用不應成'；'處時定如夢　身不定如鬼　同見膿河等　如夢損有用'

claim: 《二十论》系统破极微外境。
locator: 维基文库逐字：'極微與六合　一應成六分　若與六同處　聚應如極微'；SEP Yogacara §3.4：'Another important cluster of arguments is meant to show that no materialist account of the sensible world is tenable. In verses 11 to 15 of the Viṃśikā…'
note: SEP 谓颂 11—15 为破唯物论段落，汉译极微颂段位于其中。

claim: SEP 将《二十论》定性为专证'唯了别'的核心文本；论敌引佛说十二处诘难。
locator: SEP Vasubandhu：'this text is dedicated to proving the central Yogācāra thesis of "appearance only" (vijñaptimātra)—that is, that everything in the many worlds of living beings is only apparent, with no real existence outside of perception.'；论敌句：'If the images of physical forms, and so on, were just consciousness, not physical things, then the Buddha would not have spoken of the existence of the sense bases of physical form, and so on. (Viṃś 5)'；汉译对应（S8 逐字）：'謂若唯識似色等現無別色等。佛不應說有色等處'
note: S2 与 S8 中英文本对读互证。

claim: '唯识家=观念论者'标签是学术争议：SEP 专节处理；世亲观念论有两层；学界三层解读；并非每部瑜伽行作品都以强意义主张唯心。
locator: SEP Vasubandhu 节标 'Controversy over Vasubandhu as "Idealist"'；'it is important to note two levels to Vasubandhu's "idealism."'；SEP Yogacara §3.1：'it is useful, and customary, to distinguish between three levels of interpretation: the level of (i) the objects of perception, (ii) the causes of our perceptions, and (iii) ultimate reality'；'While not every Yogācāra work advocates the mind- or cognition-only position in any robust sense…'
note: T01 仅以'标签争议存在'一句引用本节，本包展开为独立论证点。

claim: 三性定义与三无性（《三十颂》23—24颂）；三性分析非背书阿毗达磨实在论。
locator: SEP Yogacara §3.2：'(1) a "constructed" or "imagined nature" (parikalpita-svabhāva); (2) a "dependent nature" (paratantra-svabhāva); and (3) a "perfected nature" (pariniṣpanna-svabhāva)'；'Some Yogācāra sources (e.g., Triṃśikā verses 23–24) seek to emphasise this by characterising the three natures as three non-natures or naturelessnesses (niḥsvabhāvatā)'；'the three-nature analysis is not meant to be an endorsement of the Abhidharma metaphysics of ultimately real dharmas'；汉译（S9 逐字）：'即依此三性　立彼三無性　故佛密意說　一切法無性'
note: SEP 标注颂号与维基文库夹注本编号（２３／２４）吻合。

claim: 唯识—中观论辩双向结构：《解深密经》第三转法轮判教 vs 中观破斥与月称批判、后期会通。
locator: SEP Yogacara §1.2：'The Saṃdhinirmocana Sūtra is particularly known for its self-description as the "third turning of the wheel of the doctrine", by which it means that the Yogācāra tenets represent the culmination and definitive interpretation of the Buddha's teachings, in contrast to the earlier "inadequate" expositions offered by the Abhidharma and Madhyamaka schools.'；SEP Madhyamaka：'Early Mādhyamikas tended to refute the Yogācāra doctrine that all the contents within awareness arise out of awareness itself and are thus ontologically at one with consciousness. Later Mādhyamikas found room for that view, usually by portraying Yogācāra as a philosophy that prepares one…'；'One further Buddhist movement that Candrakīrti criticizes is the Yogācāra school, which he presents as advocating a form of subjective idealism.'；'the Yogācāra philosophers fail to acknowledge that everything, including consciousness itself, is empty.'
note: 月称所依经教解读句：'Candrakīrti explains these scriptures as examples of teachings that the Buddha gave to counter a particular kind of commonly held wrong view.'

claim: 汉传新旧两译：旧译（地论/摄论）与佛性思想混合；新译（玄奘—护法）为唯識今學。
locator: Wikipedia East Asian Yogācāra：'the "Old Translation 舊譯 (Jiù yì)" or "Ancient Vijnaptimatra 唯識古學 (Wéishí gǔxué)" schools, which refers to the earliest traditions to develop in China prior to Xuanzang, primarily the Dilun and Shelun, which heavily blends buddha-nature thought with Yogācāra'；'the "New Translation 新譯 (Xīn yì)" or "Contemporary Vijnaptimatra 唯識今學 (Wéishí jīnxué)" Schools, which refers specifically to the tradition of Xuanzang and tends to focus much more strictly on mainstream Yogācāra philosophy following the Indian master Dharmapala'

claim: 玄奘糅译《成唯识论》：本于那烂陀师从戒贤等；十家注释名单。
locator: Wikipedia Cheng Weishi Lun：'The CWSL was written by the early Tang dynasty monk Xuanzang (602–664), who drew on numerous Indian Yogacara sources and scholars as well as his experience of studying under Indian Yogacara masters like Nalanda's Śīlabhadra and Prasenajit.'；'he is said to have studied ten commentaries on Vasubandhu's Triṃśikā-vijñaptimātratā, those of: Dharmapala, Sthiramati, Nanda, Citrabhanu, Bandhusri, Suddhacandra, Jinaputra, Gunamati, Jinamitra, and Jñanacandra.'
uncertainty: 十家名单来源用 'is said to have studied'，照录其口吻。

claim: 窥基'护法为正义'声明及现代学者部分修正；窥基为法相宗创立者。
locator: Wikipedia Cheng Weishi Lun：'Kuiji claimed that the interpretations of Dharmapāla were the only correct ones found in the CWSL and that Xuanzang follows the views of Dharmapāla. However, modern scholars have found that Kuiji often attributes to Dharmapāla certain interpretations which are actually found in the works of Sthiramati.'；Wikipedia Kuiji：'became foundations of the Faxiang School, the dominant school of Yogācāra thought in East Asia. He is accordingly considered the founder of this school which differed notably from Paramārtha's earlier Chinese Yogācāra system.'

claim: 圆测与窥基分歧；九识（无垢识）说被玄奘、窥基拒斥；道昭660年携卷入日。
locator: Wikipedia Cheng Weishi Lun：'The Korean monk Woncheuk, another influential pupil of Xuanzang, wrote his own commentary, the Chéng Wéishì Lùn Ceshu, which disagrees with several of Kuiji's positions.'；'This tradition defended Parāmartha's teaching that there was a ninth consciousness called the "pure consciousness" (amalavijñāna). This position had been rejected by Xuanzang and Kuiji.'；'the Japanese monk Dōshō (道昭, 629–700 CE) brought the CWSL to Japan in 660, creating the doctrinal foundation for the Japanese Consciousness-only (Jp: Hossō) school at Nara's Gangōji Temple.'
note: 圆测条目未载生卒年，本包不作具体年代断言。
uncertainty: 圆测生卒未见于本包来源。

claim: 无著：世亲同母兄，瑜伽行综合的阐扬者，《瑜伽师地论》传统署名（实为编纂），《摄大乘论》作者。
locator: SEP Vasubandhu：'Vasubandhu's elder half-brother was Asaṅga, the monk who meditated in solitude for twelve years until he was able to meet with and receive teachings directly from the future Buddha, Maitreya. Asaṅga thereby became the preeminent expounder of the Yogācāra synthesis of "Great Vehicle" (Mahāyāna) Buddhism'；SEP Yogacara：'The Yogācārabhūmi is traditionally ascribed to Asaṅga (or, according to the Chinese tradition, to Asaṅga's teacher, Maitreya), but most scholars today agree that it is a compilation consisting of several heterogeneous layers'；三性处引 'Asaṅga's Mahāyānasaṃgraha'
note: '弥勒五论'：SEP Vasubandhu 载 'transmitting the so-called "Five Treatises" revealed by Maitreya'——传记叙述。无著站外人物。

claim: 世亲：《二十论》《三十颂》作者；Frauwallner 两个世亲假说；转宗故事被质疑。
locator: SEP Vasubandhu：'In the 1950s Erich Frauwallner proposed a thesis that there were two separate Vasubandhus, whom the traditional biographies mistakenly combined into one figure.'；'Some scholars have called into question the story of Vasubandhu's conversion from Śrāvaka (non-Mahāyāna) to Yogācāra under the influence of his brother Asaṅga'；维基文库两论页署'婆藪槃豆造／世親菩薩造　玄奘譯'（S8、S9 页首署名行）

claim: 陈那：《集量论》为代表作；《观所缘缘论》延续世亲论证；立自证分（第三分）。
locator: SEP Yogacara §3.5：'Dignāga's magnum opus is the Pramāṇasamuccaya (vṛtti) ("Compendium on the Means of Valid Cognition with Commentary"), which sets out his views on logic and epistemology.'；'Dignāga's Ālambanaparīkṣā can be seen as a continuation and elaboration of Vasubandhu's idealist arguments in the Viṃśikā.'；Wikipedia Yogacara：'Dignāga accepted a third part, the self-cognizing part (svasaṃvitti-bhāga), which refers to consciousness' reflexive knowing within any act of cognition.'
note: 站外人物。年代从 S1：c. late 5th to early 6th century CE。

claim: 护法：约6世纪；立第四分（对自证之认知）；十家释中被窥基指定为正义（声明有争议）。
locator: SEP Yogacara：'most notably Sthiramati and Dharmapāla (both dated to the c. 6th century CE)'；Wikipedia Yogacara：'Dharmapāla added to this yet a fourth part, the cognition of self-cognition, which is the resulting awareness that one is self-aware.'；Wikipedia CWSL：窥基声明句（见 /school/overview 条目）
note: 站外人物。

claim: 玄奘（602—664）：那烂陀师从戒贤等；糅译《成唯识论》；新译开创。

claim: 窥基（632—682）：玄奘弟子，协作于《成唯识论》，撰《述记》《义林章》，法相宗创立者；亦撰《因明入正理論疏》。
locator: Wikipedia Kuiji：'Kuiji (窺基; Kuījī; 632–682) … was a Chinese monk and a prominent disciple of Xuanzang.'；'Kuiji collaborated closely with Xuanzang on the Cheng weishi lun, a redacted translation of commentaries on Vasubandhu's Triṃśikā-vijñaptimātratā.'；works 列表见该条目（Great Commentary on the Nyayapravesa 因明入正理論疏，Taishō 1840）

claim: 月称（约7世纪初）：批判瑜伽行为主观观念论，主张意识亦空。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka §5.1：'Modern scholars place him at the beginning of the seventh century.'；批判句：'One further Buddhist movement that Candrakīrti criticizes is the Yogācāra school, which he presents as advocating a form of subjective idealism.'；'The Yogācāra offers good reasons to show that the contents of consciousness are conditioned and therefore are empty of inherent existence, but they fail to appreciate that exactly the same can be said of awareness itself.'
note: 站外人物。批判针对学派整体，关系端点定位见 relations/7 注记。

claim: 圆测：玄奘有影响的弟子，撰《成唯识论测疏》与窥基立异，属摄论传统坚持九识说。
locator: Wikipedia Cheng Weishi Lun：'The Korean monk Woncheuk, another influential pupil of Xuanzang, wrote his own commentary, the Chéng Wéishì Lùn Ceshu, which disagrees with several of Kuiji's positions. Woncheuk was a follower of the Shelun school (攝論宗) of Yogacara, which draws on the work of Paramārtha (499–569). This tradition defended Parāmartha's teaching that there was a ninth consciousness called the "pure consciousness" (amalavijñāna).'
note: 站外人物；站内《韩国哲学》正文提及'圆测、元晓等僧侣开创了……华严与唯识思想'（school_韩国哲学.json overview，python 定位）。生卒年来源未载，不作断言。
uncertainty: 圆测生卒未见于本包来源。

claim: 陈那→护法：识分说二分→三分→四分递进；各分与三性配属有分歧。
